bagPolicy.summary: Made in America does not publish one universal bag rule for every event. Review the official event information before arrival because size and type restrictions may vary.
bagPolicy.note: No current Made in America edition is posted. Historical festival rules should not be assumed to apply to a future event; use the official site if a new edition is announced.

parking.note: No current festival transportation or parking plan is published. Do not use unrelated museum directions as festival guidance; consult the official event site if a new edition is announced.

rideshare.note: A dedicated rideshare zone was not confirmed in Made in America's current published guidance. Follow the event page and your rideshare app on show day, and use only signed pickup or drop-off areas.

concessions.note: The National Constitution Center offers a variety of food and beverage options including Delegates' Cafe and Starbucks. Delegates' Cafe features salads, sandwiches, and daily specials like Philly cheesesteaks, while Starbucks provides handcrafted beverages and premium teas. Catering and boxed lunch options are available for groups.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: After using ADA Entry, please visit the Accessibility Services Hub so that you can use ADA Entry for the rest of the event.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: A venue-wide re-entry rule was not confirmed in Made in America's current published guidance. Treat exit as final unless event staff explicitly confirms re-entry before you leave.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: Lost and Found will be open from 11am-4pm on Monday, September 5th at the box office, located at Aviator Park (outside the venue’s main entrance). Will call is located at Aviator Park.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Entrance assignments and door times are event-specific at Made in America. Use the entrance shown on the official event page or ticket, arrive early for screening, and follow on-site signage.
